Attune 0.0.7 broadens Calibre migration, reading formats, and reader-device support.

- Import multi-format Calibre records with their book files, metadata, custom-column values, and reading-state data preserved where possible.
- Read EPUB, MOBI/AZW3, FB2, TXT, PDF, CBZ, and CBR books.
- Transfer existing compatible formats to supported reader profiles over mounted USB storage or MTP, while retaining EPUB-to-MOBI conversion for Kindle.

Reader and MTP compatibility remains early-alpha. Device profiles and operations still need hardware verification across models and platforms; see the capability matrix for current coverage.
